system.description:
You can only cast this jutsu while your Bio-Pet is active. You dispel them, unsummoning them into a pocket dimension, filled with your chakra that it feeds on growing in size, until it becomes Huge for a split second. During this moment, you reverse summon the Bio-Pet back, selecting an area 10 feet above the ground to summon them. When you do, it falls crashing into the ground. All creatures whose space overlaps with your Bio-Pet must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they are crushed under your Pet, taking 3d12 bludgeoning damage being knocked Prone and Bruised on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

After damage is calculated, your Bio-Pets size reverts back to small into a space that can hold it.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
